verses.original: וַתֹּ֥אמֶר לָ֖הּ נָעֳמִ֣י חֲמוֹתָ֑הּ בִּתִּ֞י הֲלֹ֧א אֲבַקֶּשׁ־ לָ֛ךְ מָנ֖וֹחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽיטַב־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lāh nā·‘o·mî ḥă·mō·w·ṯāh bit·tî hă·lō ’ă·ḇaq·qeš- lāḵ mā·nō·w·aḥ ’ă·šer yî·ṭaḇ- lāḵ
verses.literal: One day Ruth’s mother-in-law Naomi said to her My daughter should I not seek a resting place for you that it may be well with you
verses.literalPt: E DISSE-LHE Noemi, sua sogra: Minha filha, não hei de buscar descanso, para que fiques bem?

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הֲלֹ֥א בֹ֙עַז֙ מֹֽדַעְתָּ֔נוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֖ית אֶת־ נַעֲרוֹתָ֑יו הִנֵּה־ ה֗וּא זֹרֶ֛ה אֶת־ גֹּ֥רֶן הַשְּׂעֹרִ֖ים הַלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hă·lō ḇō·‘az mō·ḏa‘·tā·nū ’ă·šer hā·yîṯ ’eṯ- na·‘ă·rō·w·ṯāw hin·nêh- hū zō·reh ’eṯ- gō·ren haś·śə·‘ō·rîm hal·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: Now is not Boaz with whose servant girls you have been working a relative of ours In fact tonight he is winnowing barley on the threshing floor
verses.literalPt: Ora, pois, não é Boaz, com cujas moças estiveste, de nossa parentela? Eis que esta noite padejará a cevada na eira.

verses.original: וְרָחַ֣צְתְּ׀ וָסַ֗כְתְּ וְשַׂ֧מְתְּ שִׂמְלֹתֵךְ עָלַ֖יִךְ וְיָרַדְתִּי הַגֹּ֑רֶן אַל־ תִּוָּדְעִ֣י לָאִ֔ישׁ עַ֥ד כַּלֹּת֖וֹ לֶאֱכֹ֥ל וְלִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḥaṣt wā·saḵt wə·śamt śim·lō·ṯēḵ ‘ā·la·yiḵ wə·yå̄·raḏ·tī hag·gō·ren ’al- tiw·wā·ḏə·‘î lā·’îš ‘aḏ kal·lō·ṯōw le·’ĕ·ḵōl wə·liš·tō·wṯ
verses.literal: Therefore wash yourself put on perfume and wear your best clothes . . . Go down to the threshing floor but do not let the man know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking
verses.literalPt: Lava-te, pois, e unge-te, e veste os teus vestidos, e desce à eira; porém não te dês a conhecer ao homem, até que tenha acabado de comer e beber.

verses.original: וִיהִ֣י בְשָׁכְב֗וֹ וְיָדַ֙עַתְּ֙ אֶת־ הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁכַּב־ שָׁ֔ם וּבָ֛את וְגִלִּ֥ית מַרְגְּלֹתָ֖יו וְשָׁכָבְתִּי וְהוּא֙ יַגִּ֣יד לָ֔ךְ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעַשִֽׂין׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hî ḇə·šā·ḵə·ḇōw wə·yā·ḏa·‘at ’eṯ- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiš·kaḇ- šām ū·ḇāṯ wə·ḡil·lîṯ mar·gə·lō·ṯāw wə·šå̄·ḵå̄·ḇə·tī wə·hū yag·gîḏ lāḵ ’êṯ ’ă·šer ta·ʿa·śīn
verses.literal: When he lies down note the place where he lies . . . Then go in and uncover his feet and lie down and he will explain to you what you should do
verses.literalPt: E há de ser que, quando ele se deitar, notarás o lugar em que se deitar; então entrarás, e descobrir-lhe-ás os pés, e te deitarás, e ele te fará saber o que deves fazer.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֶ֑יהָ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאמְרִ֥יֵַ֖ אֶֽעֱשֶֽׂה׃
verses.literal: I will do everything you say Ruth answered
verses.literalPt: E ela lhe disse: Tudo quanto me disseres, farei.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֖רֶד הַגֹּ֑רֶן וַתַּ֕עַשׂ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוַּ֖תָּה חֲמוֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·reḏ hag·gō·ren wat·ta·‘aś kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wat·tāh ḥă·mō·w·ṯāh
verses.literal: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law had instructed her to do
verses.literalPt: Então foi para a eira, e fez conforme a tudo quanto sua sogra lhe tinha ordenado.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אכַל בֹּ֤עַז וַיֵּשְׁתְּ֙ וַיִּיטַ֣ב לִבּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֕א לִשְׁכַּ֖ב בִּקְצֵ֣ה הָעֲרֵמָ֑ה וַתָּבֹ֣א בַלָּ֔ט וַתְּגַ֥ל מַרְגְּלֹתָ֖יו וַתִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ḵal bō·‘az way·yê·šət way·yî·ṭaḇ lib·bōw way·yā·ḇō liš·kaḇ biq·ṣêh hā·‘ă·rê·māh wat·tā·ḇō ḇal·lāṭ wat·tə·ḡal mar·gə·lō·ṯāw wat·tiš·kāḇ
verses.literal: After Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits . . . he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain Then Ruth went in secretly . . . uncovered his feet and lay down
verses.literalPt: Havendo, pois, Boaz comido e bebido, e estando já o seu coração alegre, veio deitar-se ao pé de um monte de grãos; então veio ela de mansinho, e lhe descobriu os pés, e se deitou.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ בַּחֲצִ֣י הַלַּ֔יְלָה וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד הָאִ֖ישׁ וַיִּלָּפֵ֑ת וְהִנֵּ֣ה אִשָּׁ֔ה שֹׁכֶ֖בֶת מַרְגְּלֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ba·ḥă·ṣî hal·lay·lāh way·ye·ḥĕ·raḏ hā·’îš way·yil·lā·p̄êṯ wə·hin·nêh ’iš·šāh šō·ḵe·ḇeṯ mar·gə·lō·ṯāw
verses.literal: At midnight . . . Boaz was startled turned over and there lying at his feet was a woman
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, pela meia noite, o homem estremeceu, e se voltou; e eis que uma mulher jazia a seus pés.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־ אָ֑תּ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אָנֹכִי֙ ר֣וּת אֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ֤ כְנָפֶ֙ךָ֙ עַל־ אֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ כִּ֥י גֹאֵ֖ל אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mî- ʾå̄t wat·tō·mer ’ā·nō·ḵî rūṯ ’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā ū·p̄ā·raś·tā ḵə·nā·p̄e·ḵā ‘al- ’ă·mā·ṯə·ḵā kî ḡō·’êl ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: Who are you he asked I am your servant Ruth she replied Spread the corner of your garment over me for you are a kinsman-redeemer
verses.literalPt: E disse ele: Quem és tu? E ela disse: Sou Rute, tua serva; estende pois tua capa sobre a tua serva, porque tu és o remidor.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בְּרוּכָ֨ה אַ֤תְּ לַֽיהוָה֙ בִּתִּ֔י הֵיטַ֛בְתְּ חַסְדֵּ֥ךְ הָאַחֲר֖וֹן מִן־ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן לְבִלְתִּי־ לֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵי֙ הַבַּ֣חוּרִ֔ים אִם־ דַּ֖ל וְאִם־ עָשִֽׁיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bə·rū·ḵāh ’at Yah·weh bit·tî hê·ṭaḇt ḥas·dêḵ hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn min- hā·ri·šō·wn lə·ḇil·tî- le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·rê hab·ba·ḥū·rîm ’im- dal wə·’im- ‘ā·šîr
verses.literal: Then Boaz said May the LORD bless you my daughter You have shown more kindness now than before because you have not run after the younger men whether rich or poor
verses.literalPt: E disse ele: Bendita sejas tu do SENHOR, minha filha; melhor fizeste esta tua última benevolência do que a primeira, pois após nenhum dos jovens foste, quer pobre quer rico.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה בִּתִּי֙ אַל־ תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאמְרִ֖י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּ֑ךְ כִּ֤י יוֹדֵ֙עַ֙ כָּל־ שַׁ֣עַר עַמִּ֔י כִּ֛י אֵ֥שֶׁת חַ֖יִל אָֽתְּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh bit·tî ’al- tî·rə·’î kōl ’ă·šer- tō·mə·rî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ kî yō·w·ḏê·a‘ kāl- ša·‘ar ‘am·mî kî ’ê·šeṯ ḥa·yil ’āt
verses.literal: And now do not be afraid my daughter I will do for you whatever you request since all my fellow townspeople . . . know that you are a woman of noble character
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, minha filha, não temas; tudo quanto disseste te farei, pois toda a cidade do meu povo sabe que és mulher virtuosa.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ כִּ֣י אָמְנָ֔ם כִּ֥י אם גֹאֵ֖ל אָנֹ֑כִי וְגַ֛ם יֵ֥שׁ גֹּאֵ֖ל קָר֥וֹב מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh kî ’ā·mə·nām kî m ḡō·’êl ’ā·nō·ḵî wə·ḡam yêš gō·’êl qā·rō·wḇ mim·men·nî
verses.literal: Yes it is true that I am a kinsman-redeemer but there is a redeemer nearer than I
verses.literalPt: Porém agora é verdade que eu sou remidor, mas ainda outro remidor há mais chegado do que eu.

verses.original: לִ֣ינִי׀ הַלַּ֗יְלָה וְהָיָ֤ה בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ אִם־ יִגְאָלֵ֥ךְ טוֹב֙ יִגְאָ֔ל וְאִם־ לֹ֨א יַחְפֹּ֧ץ לְגָֽאֳלֵ֛ךְ וּגְאַלְתִּ֥יךְ אָנֹ֖כִי חַי־ יְהוָ֑ה שִׁכְבִ֖י עַד־ הַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: lî·nî hal·lay·lāh wə·hā·yāh ḇab·bō·qer ’im- yiḡ·’ā·lêḵ ṭō·wḇ yiḡ·’āl wə·’im- lō yaḥ·pōṣ lə·ḡā·’o·lêḵ ū·ḡə·’al·tîḵ ’ā·nō·ḵî ḥay- Yah·weh šiḵ·ḇî ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer
verses.literal: Stay here tonight . . . . . . and in the morning if he wants to redeem you good Let him redeem you But if he does not want to redeem you as surely as the LORD lives I will Now lie here until morning
verses.literalPt: Fica-te aqui esta noite, e será que, pela manhã, se ele te redimir, bem está, que te redima; porém, se não quiser te redimir, vive o SENHOR, que eu te redimirei. Deita-te aqui até amanhã.

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁכַּ֤ב מַרְגְּלֹתָו עַד־ הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַתָּ֕קָם בִּטְרוֹם יַכִּ֥יר אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַל־ יִוָּדַ֔ע כִּי־ בָ֥אָה הָאִשָּׁ֖ה הַגֹּֽרֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·kaḇ mar·gə·lō·ṯå̄w ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer wat·tā·qām biṭ·rōm yak·kîr ’îš ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū way·yō·mer ’al- yiw·wā·ḏa‘ kî- ḇā·’āh hā·’iš·šāh hag·gō·ren
verses.literal: So she lay down at his feet until morning but she got up before anyone else could recognize her Then Boaz said Do not let it be known that a woman came to the threshing floor
verses.literalPt: Ficou-se, pois, deitada a seus pés até pela manhã, e levantou-se antes que pudesse um conhecer o outro, porquanto disse: Não se saiba que alguma mulher veio à eira.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הָ֠בִי הַמִּטְפַּ֧חַת אֲשֶׁר־ עָלַ֛יִךְ וְאֶֽחֳזִי־ בָ֖הּ וַתֹּ֣אחֶז בָּ֑הּ וַיָּ֤מָד שֵׁשׁ־ שְׂעֹרִים֙ וַיָּ֣שֶׁת עָלֶ֔יהָ וַיָּבֹ֖א הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hā·ḇî ham·miṭ·pa·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·la·yiḵ wə·’e·ḥo·zî- ḇāh wat·tō·ḥez bāh way·yā·māḏ šêš- śə·‘ō·rîm way·yā·šeṯ ‘ā·le·hā way·yā·ḇō hā·‘îr
verses.literal: And he told her Bring the shawl you are wearing and hold it out When she did so . . . he poured in six measures of barley and placed it on her Then he went into the city
verses.literalPt: Disse mais: Dá-me a capa que tens sobre ti, e segura-a. E ela a segurou; e ele mediu seis medidas de cevada, e lhas pôs em cima; então foi para a cidade.

verses.original: וַתָּבוֹא֙ אֶל־ חֲמוֹתָ֔הּ וַתֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־ אַ֣תְּ בִּתִּ֑י וַתַּ֨גֶּד־ לָ֔הּ אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָֽשָׂה־ לָ֖הּ הָאִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō·w ’el- ḥă·mō·w·ṯāh wat·tō·mer mî- ’at bit·tî wat·tag·geḏ- lāh ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh- lāh hā·’îš
verses.literal: When Ruth returned to her mother-in-law Naomi asked her How did it go . . . my daughter Then Ruth told her all that Boaz had done for her
verses.literalPt: E foi à sua sogra, que lhe disse: Como foi, minha filha? E ela lhe contou tudo quanto aquele homem lhe fizera.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר שֵׁשׁ־ הַשְּׂעֹרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה נָ֣תַן לִ֑י כִּ֚י אָמַ֣רֵַ֔ אַל־ תָּב֥וֹאִי רֵיקָ֖ם אֶל־ חֲמוֹתֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer šêš- haś·śə·‘ō·rîm hā·’êl·leh nā·ṯan lî kî ʾå̄·ma·ra ’al- tā·ḇō·w·’î rê·qām ’el- ḥă·mō·w·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: And she said He gave me these six measures of barley for he said Do not go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed
verses.literalPt: Disse mais: Estas seis medidas de cevada me deu, porque me disse: Não vás vazia à tua sogra.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ שְׁבִ֣י בִתִּ֔י עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽדְעִ֔ין אֵ֖יךְ יִפֹּ֣ל דָּבָ֑ר כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יִשְׁקֹט֙ הָאִ֔ישׁ כִּֽי־ אִם־ כִּלָּ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer šə·ḇî ḇit·tî ‘aḏ ’ă·šer tê·ḏə·‘în ’êḵ yip·pōl dā·ḇār kî lō yiš·qōṭ hā·’îš kî- ’im- kil·lāh had·dā·ḇār hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Wait my daughter said Naomi until you find out how things go for he will not rest unless . . . he has resolved the matter today
verses.literalPt: Então disse ela: Espera, minha filha, até que saibas como irá o caso, porque aquele homem não descansará até que conclua hoje este negócio.
